caption_instagram:
Harassment at work is not something you have to 'just ignore'. 🚫

🏢 Every workplace with 10 or more employees must have an Internal Committee (POSH Act, 2013)
🗓️ A complaint can be made within 3 months of the incident; the Committee can extend this by up to 3 more months
⏱️ The inquiry must be completed within 90 days
🛡️ During the inquiry, the Committee can recommend interim relief such as a transfer or leave of up to 3 months
💻 Complaints can also be filed online on the SHe-Box portal: shebox.wcd.gov.in
⚖️ Employers who don't comply can face a penalty of up to ₹50,000

caption_linkedin:
A safe workplace is a legal duty, not a perk. Key points of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 — the POSH Act — that every employee and employer should know:

• Internal Committee: every workplace employing 10 or more employees must constitute an Internal Committee. Where there is none, a complaint goes to the Local Committee of the district.
• Time limit: a complaint can be made within 3 months of the incident; the Committee may extend this by up to 3 more months, recording its reasons.
• Inquiry: the inquiry must be completed within 90 days. During it, the Committee may recommend interim relief such as transfer or leave of up to 3 months.
• Online: complaints can also be filed and tracked on the Government's SHe-Box portal (shebox.wcd.gov.in).
• Compliance: an employer who fails to comply can face a penalty of up to ₹50,000.

For guidance on workplace matters, you can consult a Bar Council-verified advocate online on AdvocateSetu: https://advocatesetu.com
